name: @tiny-patchwork/weather
description: A world's weather as physical data: where and when (lat/lon, date, hour on a UTC-offset clock), the air (wind, gusts) and the sky (cloud cover, kind and base, visibility, rain). A scene trait offers it as the world's `wind` and `atmosphere` ambients, the sun from a solar-position algorithm, so every peer and the sim agree. Dial it in, or fetch a place's real conditions from Open-Meteo into the doc. Built only from scene extensions.
